title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student provides the correct final expression for the minimum number of windings around the pole.

title: Force Balance
description: Important Criteria: The student correctly applies the balance of forces on the differential segment of the rope.

title: Friction Relation
description: Important Criteria: The student incorporates the relationship between tension change and friction coefficient correctly.

title: Exponential Growth
description: Important Criteria: The student recognizes the exponential relationship between tensions at the ends of the rope.

title: Units Check
description: Optional Criteria: The student checks that the units of the final answer are consistent and valid.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student makes a sign mistake in the tension relationships or inequalities.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student fails to include the factor of 2π in the final expression for windings.
